{"topic":"app-manual","bytes":1129,"guide":"## THE MEDIA TAB — pictures, clips and audio: All, Images, Videos, Audio, Filter, search, rounds, cards, selecting, importing, dragging

### Media: how to find something (search, filter, favorites, folder, a picture is missing)

1. Type in **Search**: it matches prompts.
2. Press the heart for favorites only.
3. Open **Filter** to hide **Generated**, **Imported** or a Library category, or (Images) to show **Only with linked videos**.
4. Click a folder under **Folders** in the left dock; new pictures then land there too.
5. The view line names each narrowing with an ×. On an empty grid press **Show all media**.

If a picture seems gone, check the view line first: a folder, a search or a hidden **Imported** row is the usual cause.

{"topic":"app-manual","bytes":2169,"guide":"## THE LEFT DOCK (PROJECT NAVIGATOR) — Boards, scenes, Library categories and items, Folders, Pinned references

### Left dock: Folders (new folder, make a folder, All media, No folder, open a folder, file media)

| Control | Where | What it does | Key | Agent op |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `+` (tooltip **New folder**) | **Folders** title line | Opens a create row at the bottom. The new folder is not opened | — | slates_create_folder |
| Create field (**Folder name**) | Create row | `Enter` creates. A name another folder has (case ignored) is refused under the field | `Enter`, `Escape` | slates_create_folder |
| **All media** | Folders, first row | Opens Media with no folder chosen and every file. Lit while Media's grid shows that | — | slates_set_view (media.folderId) |
| **No folder** | Folders, second row | Opens Media narrowed to files in no folder. Drop media on it to take it out of its folder. Tooltip **Drop media here to take it out of its folder** | — | slates_set_view (media.unfiledOnly) |
| Folder row | One per folder | Its cover picture (or a folder icon), name and file count. Click opens Media filtered to it and chooses it (next section). Drop media on it to file it. Tooltip **Drop media here to file it**. Drag to reorder | `F2` renames | slates_move_assets_to_folder, slates_rename_folder, slates_reorder_folders |

Opening a folder from a Library page returns Media to the last media tab. **All media** and **No folder** have no menu and cannot be renamed. Other doors: `Ctrl+K` → **New folder**, **Rename folder · {name}**, **Delete folder · {name}**; right-click empty Media space → **New folder**; a card's **Move to folder** submenu. Two folders cannot share a name (case ignored). A folder shows a cover picture only when an agent sets one (`slates_set_folder_cover`).

Related sections (ask by heading): Left dock: how to file media into a folder and make new pictures land there · Left dock: drag and drop (reorder rows, file media into a folder, drop targets) · Media: how to file media into folders (Move to folder, New folder, drag) · Left dock: folder menu (rename folder, delete folder, delete its files too)"}

## Suggested folders

Media already splits files by type with the **Images / Videos / Audio** tabs, so name folders by what the files are for:

- **Talent – Mara**: IMG-A1, VID-V1
- **Product**: IMG-A2 (hero can) and future packshots
- **Pour & Ice**: IMG-A3 and other macro/texture shots
- **Voiceover**: AUD-S1 and later VO takes

As you go:
- **Use favorites for your picks.** Press the heart on the take you're keeping (e.g., your best VO take). The favorites filter then shows only those.
- **Put new work straight into a folder.** Click a folder under **Folders** in the left dock before generating, and new pictures will land there. **No folder** shows anything left unfiled.
- **Give files clear labels**, like "VO take 2 – slower read." Search matches prompts, so specific labels and prompts make things easier to find.

## Doing it yourself
In the left dock, click **+** (New folder) next to **Folders**, type a name and press Enter. Then drag cards onto a folder, or right-click a card and use **Move to folder**.

Or I can create the four folders and file the five assets for you. It doesn't cost any credits. Want me to go ahead, or change the folder names first?
